task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of flight AA100, then prepare a business-class booking request for Jordan Lee and get its gate board information, and after that archive that flight board in the app as “Trip flight archive.” Then look up Hilton Tokyo and book a deluxe room for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-03, scan for devices in the living room, check the living room light status and set that light to 65% brightness, and finally create a high-priority app alert titled “Travel setup completed” with the content “New York JFK -> Los Angeles LAX” and tags for travel, hotel, and iot.

user_input.query: For user_id u_alice, please check the status of flight AA100, then prepare a business-class booking request for Jordan Lee and get its gate board information. After that, archive that flight board in the app as “Trip flight archive.” Then look up Hilton Tokyo and book a deluxe room for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-03. Also scan for devices in the living_room, check the status of light_living, and set that light to 65% brightness. Finally, create a high-priority app alert titled “Travel setup completed” with the content “New York JFK -> Los Angeles LAX” and tags travel, hotel, and iot.
